about: Model verdicts on source against tree for adb (system/rag/semcheck.py).

findings.problem: The header that spans the four distance columns is not in the column names, so the columns do not say what the distance is measured from.
findings.evidence: source: "Distance from any point on relevant boundary" / tree columns: "Less than 6m", "At least 6m", "At least 12m", "At least 20m"
